name: scenecap
description: Loopback-only MCP sidecar for safe OBS recording control.

scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module --eval "import { Client } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js'; import { StreamableHTTPClientTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/streamableHttp.js'; const client = new Client({ name: 'scenecap-smoke', version: '0.1.0' }); await client.connect(new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(new URL('http://127.0.0.1:3233/mcp'))); try { console.log(JSON.stringify({ tools: await client.listTools(), status: await client.callTool({ name: 'get_status', arguments: {} }), targets: await client.callTool({ name: 'list_capture_targets', arguments: {} }) }, null, 2)); } finally { await client.close(); }"
